# UBC-FRESH Dev Workflow

> Agent-facing index for the UBC-FRESH dev workflow seed. Read the linked pages before you change a project. They are the source of truth for the workflow contract.

## Start here

- [Session protocol](agents/session-protocol.html): the steps to follow at the start of every session.
- [Workflow model](reference/workflow-model.html): phases, tasks, subtasks, IDs, and status values.
- [Approval gates](reference/approval-gates.html): what an agent may do without asking, and what waits for approval.
- [Phase close-out](reference/phase-closeout.html): how a phase ends, with its report, its approval, and its execution.

## Reference

- [GitHub mapping](reference/github-mapping.html): parent and child issues, branches, pull requests, and closure.
- [Issue standard](reference/issue-standard.html): required sections and formatting rules for issue bodies.
- [Lifecycle stages and gates](reference/lifecycle.html): the six stages, their entry and exit criteria, and the owner of each gate.
- [Git conventions](reference/git-conventions.html): branch names, commit messages, and pull request titles.
- [Quality gates](reference/quality-gates.html): the gates that form the green dashboard, and the CI jobs.
- [Testing policy](reference/testing-policy.html): the layers of tests, and the coverage gate.
- [Typing and docstrings](reference/typing-and-docstrings.html): the annotation and docstring rules.

## Agents

- [Bounded moves](agents/bounded-moves.html): what counts as one unit of work, and the scope-breach rule.
- [Oracles and evidence](agents/oracles-and-evidence.html): evidence standards and the validator's finding codes.
- [RTFM protocol](agents/rtfm.html): how to read, cite, and fix the docs.
- [Green dashboard](agents/green-dashboard.html): the rule for any change from full green.
- [Embedded capabilities](agents/embedded-capabilities.html): the contract for validated, advisory capabilities, with a conformance checklist.
- [Basecamp pings for blocking decisions](agents/basecamp-pings.html): agent-owned identity, when to ping, the message contract, and the no-polling rule.
- [Agent roles and models](agents/roles-and-models.html): the roles, the task families, the rule for choosing a model, and the log of each choice.

## API

- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.
- [check_workflow](api/check-workflow.html): the validator, and the finding codes it reports.
- [dashboard](api/dashboard.html): the green dashboard, its gates, and its exit status.
- [new_project](api/new-project.html): the initializer that renders the seed.

## Guides

- [Onboarding](guides/onboarding.html): a guided tour for new people.
- [Starting a new project](guides/first-project.html): from the seed to a reviewed first pull request.
- [Release and deployment](guides/release.html): the release checklist, the tag, release, and Pages steps, PyPI for packages, and the archival DOI.
- [Data management](guides/data-management.html): where data lives, private vaults, DataLad and git-annex, sanitized artifacts, and why raw transcripts stay local.
- [FRESH-style dev server](guides/dev-server/index.html): the reference environment and its security notes.
